name: Cool Editor Tabs
description: Restyles Drupal's local task tabs (View, Edit, Translate, ...) into a floating, icon-based pop-up menu for authenticated editors.
project_description:
Cool Editor Tabs restyles Drupal's local task tabs (View, Edit, Translate, Delete, Revisions, ...) into a compact, icon-based menu. A single settings/gear toggle button is fixed to the bottom-right of the screen; clicking it expands the local tasks as circular icon buttons. It is achieved almost entirely in CSS (only a small toggle behaviour uses JavaScript). The restyled tabs appear only for authenticated users holding the 'use cool editor tabs' permission and only on non-admin routes, so anonymous visitors are unaffected.

How it works:
- hook_page_attachments() attaches the admin_tabs library (CSS + toggle JS) for any authenticated user with the permission, and injects the five configurable colours as CSS custom properties (:root variables) after validating each as a strict hex colour.
- Theme suggestion + preprocess hooks swap the menu_local_task(s) / menu_local_action templates for the module's 'better' variants on non-admin routes, replacing each tab title with an SVG icon (Heroicons v2) resolved from the tab's route name, with a first-letter fallback for unmatched tabs.

Features:
- Built-in icons for core tabs and popular contrib modules (Metatag, Pathauto, Redirect, Webform, Scheduler, Simple XML Sitemap, Content Moderation, Rabbit Hole, Devel, Layout Builder, Clone).
- Colour configuration at Administration -> Configuration -> User interface -> Cool Editor Tabs, with a live client-side WCAG 2.1 non-text contrast checker (3:1) on the settings form.
- Registers a Drupal Icon API icon pack (cool_editor_tabs) usable by other modules.
- Developer hook hook_cool_editor_tabs_icon_alter() to map custom route names to icons / packs.

The module is essentially a maintained fork of the abandoned better_admin_tabs project. Requires Drupal 11.1 or higher.
